resolution: Diagnosed the 'stalls when u commit' correlation; no code change needed (shas none). Both stall episodes began exactly when the agent's pipeline ran on the user's box (file-save bursts → hot-reload remounts, git push packing objects on all cores, rjit game verify = full zig build + 72 suites) and self-resolved when the agent went idle. Ruled out: no git hooks exist; the dev watcher (esbuild --watch + 200ms output-mtime poll) only rebuilds on cart/runtime input changes, so board writes and git operations don't trigger reloads; nothing in the shipped editor runs on a 500ms period. The 2Hz ~185ms pattern matches periodic file-graph rescans + editor reads hitting cold caches while git/zig churn CPU and disk — environmental contention from the agent's own tooling, not the instanced renderer. Decisive check handed to the user: with the agent fully idle, sit in the pane 30s then move the building — no stall lines = environmental (case closed); persistent ×2 lines = real in-app periodic cost, next step a GC/alloc probe. Protocol change adopted: no full game verify per commit while the user is actively editing — bundle-check + targeted tests during sessions, heavy verify batched to quiet moments.
